connector.name: Doc_Conv - Document to Markdown
connector.registryDescription: Convert PDF/Word/Excel/PowerPoint documents to Markdown, paid in USDC via x402.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package docconv-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nicklee002e account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: DOC_CONV_AGENT_PK
env.description: Private key of the agent's Base wallet (holds USDC). Signs x402 (EIP-3009) payments. Secret — never commit or share.

env.name: DOC_CONV_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Doc_Conv service. Defaults to the hosted service.
